findings.title: $__range queries are interpolated before the no-split guard
findings.body: runSplitQuery now calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables on every target before querySupportsSplitting(). That helper intentionally refuses to split expressions containing $__range / $__range_ms / $__range_s because those macros must be interpolated against each chunk's time range (the comment at the guard says the backend does that with the split range). After this change the macro is replaced using the original full request range, so isQueryWithRangeVariable() no longer matches and the query is time-split anyway. Each chunk then runs with a range duration for the whole query, producing wrong rates/counts (and the same path is hit again from runShardSplitQuery, which interpolates before delegating to runSplitQuery). The new tests only cover $__auto and $step, so this regression is untested. Preserve the range-variable check on the pre-interpolation expression and do not split those queries.
